policies.qual:
(active AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM cp.memberships m
  WHERE ((m.tenant_id = tenants.id) AND (m.account_id = platform.current_actor_id()) AND (m.status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (m.valid_from <= now()) AND ((m.valid_until IS NULL) OR (m.valid_until > now()))))))

constraints.name: arrival_requests_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((state = ANY (ARRAY['APPROVED'::text, 'DENIED'::text])) AND (decided_by IS NOT NULL) AND (decided_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((state = ANY (ARRAY['WAITING'::text, 'EXPIRED'::text])) AND (decided_by IS NULL) AND (decided_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: arrival_requests_tenant_id_unit_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, unit_id) REFERENCES cp.units(tenant_id, id)

constraints.name: memberships_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((role <> ALL (ARRAY['RESIDENT'::text, 'RESPONSIBLE'::text, 'DEPENDENT'::text, 'OWNER'::text])) OR (unit_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: memberships_tenant_id_account_id_unit_id_role_key
constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (tenant_id, account_id, unit_id, role)

constraints.name: memberships_tenant_id_unit_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, unit_id) REFERENCES cp.units(tenant_id, id)

constraints.name: parcel_handoffs_tenant_id_parcel_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, parcel_id) REFERENCES cp.parcels(tenant_id, id)

constraints.name: parcels_tenant_id_unit_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, unit_id) REFERENCES cp.units(tenant_id, id)

constraints.name: reservations_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'BOOKING'::text) AND (unit_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((kind = 'BLOCK'::text) AND (unit_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: reservations_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((isfinite(starts_at) AND isfinite(ends_at) AND isfinite(occupied_from) AND isfinite(occupied_until)))

constraints.name: reservations_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((starts_at < ends_at) AND (occupied_from <= starts_at) AND (occupied_until >= ends_at)))

constraints.name: reservations_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['HELD'::text, 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::text])) OR ((expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (expires_at <= starts_at))))

constraints.name: reservations_no_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (tenant_id WITH =, amenity_id WITH =, tstzrange(occupied_from, occupied_until, '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['HELD'::text, 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::text, 'CONFIRMED'::text])))

constraints.name: reservations_tenant_id_amenity_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, amenity_id) REFERENCES cp.amenities(tenant_id, id)

constraints.name: reservations_tenant_id_unit_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, unit_id) REFERENCES cp.units(tenant_id, id)

constraints.name: units_tenant_id_block_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, block_id) REFERENCES cp.blocks(tenant_id, id)

constraints.name: units_tenant_id_block_id_label_key
constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (tenant_id, block_id, label)
